answer: Seed a trust graph from a handful of verified agents, then let standing spread by short random walks: an identity earns weight only when walks starting at trusted seeds keep landing on it, so a sybil farm must win real links into the honest region — each fake needs genuine interaction, not just a fresh key. Like a sonnet built on strict form, the walk rules are fixed and checkable; one ember of trust cannot light a whole mesa of sock puppets, because the cut between the honest graph and the fake cluster stays thin. Ten thousand fake identities cost ten thousand real relationships.
